title.zh: Cysic 加密跨链桥在 1000 万枚 CYS 被未经授权铸造后暂停
title.en: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS

current_state.zh: Cysic 跨链桥仍处于暂停状态，涉事地址已被链上黑名单限制，约 280 万枚 CYS 无法转出；项目称主网和用户钱包资产未受影响，并已聘请安全公司调查和追踪资金。
current_state.en: The Cysic cross-chain bridge remains paused, the involved address is blacklisted on-chain with about 2.8 million CYS frozen, and the project says the mainnet and user wallet assets were unaffected while a security firm investigates and traces funds.

updates.title_zh: Cysic 加密跨链桥在 1000 万枚 CYS 被未经授权铸造后暂停
updates.title_en: Cysic crypto bridge halted after unauthorized mint of 10M CYS
updates.what_changed_zh: Cysic 在攻击者利用处理漏洞在 BNB Smart Chain 上铸造 1000 万枚 CYS 后暂停了其跨链桥，项目方已将接收地址列入黑名单，并限制约 280 万枚剩余代币的转账。
updates.what_changed_en: Cysic suspended its cross-chain bridge after an attacker exploited a processing flaw to mint 10 million CYS on BNB Smart Chain, with the project blacklisting the recipient and restricting transfers of about 2.8 million remaining tokens.
updates.current_state_zh: Cysic 在攻击者利用处理漏洞在 BNB Smart Chain 上铸造 1000 万枚 CYS 后暂停了其跨链桥，项目方已将接收地址列入黑名单，并限制约 280 万枚剩余代币的转账。
updates.current_state_en: Cysic suspended its cross-chain bridge after an attacker exploited a processing flaw to mint 10 million CYS on BNB Smart Chain, with the project blacklisting the recipient and restricting transfers of about 2.8 million remaining tokens.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Cysic suspended its cross-chain bridge after an attacker exploited a processing flaw to mint 10 million CYS on BNB Smart Chain, with the project blacklisting the recipient and restricting transfers of about 2.8 million remaining tokens.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Cysic suspended its cross-chain bridge after an attacker exploited a processing flaw to mint 10 million CYS on BNB Smart Chain, with the project blacklisting the recipient and restricting transfers of about 2.8 million remaining tokens.

updates.title_zh: 【Cysic 跨链桥遭到攻击，黑客未经授权铸造了 1000 万枚 CYS】
updates.title_en: 【Cysic 跨链桥遭到攻击，黑客未经授权铸造了 1000 万枚 CYS】
updates.what_changed_zh: Cysic 补充称攻击发生于 10 月 17 日，黑客获取跨链服务相关数据库访问权限并提交虚假铸造消息；本次事件仅影响跨链桥消息处理与铸造功能，未影响 Cysic 主网或用户钱包现有资产，团队已聘请安全公司调查攻击路径并追踪资金。
updates.what_changed_en: Cysic added that the attack occurred on October 17 after the attacker gained access to a database related to the cross-chain service and submitted false mint messages; the incident was limited to the bridge's message-processing and minting functions, did not affect the Cysic mainnet or existing assets in user wallets, and the team hired a security firm to investigate the attack path and trace funds.
updates.current_state_zh: Cysic 跨链桥仍处于暂停状态，涉事地址已被链上黑名单限制，约 280 万枚 CYS 无法转出；项目称主网和用户钱包资产未受影响，并已聘请安全公司调查和追踪资金。
updates.current_state_en: The Cysic cross-chain bridge remains paused, the involved address is blacklisted on-chain with about 2.8 million CYS frozen, and the project says the mainnet and user wallet assets were unaffected while a security firm investigates and traces funds.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Cysic's cross-chain bridge was exploited on October 17, allowing an attacker to mint 10 million CYS without authorization on BNB Chain via a logic flaw and database access, prompting the team to pause the bridge and blacklist involved addresses.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Cysic's cross-chain bridge was exploited on October 17, allowing an attacker to mint 10 million CYS without authorization on BNB Chain via a logic flaw and database access, prompting the team to pause the bridge and blacklist involved addresses.
